name: @projexlight/sdk-recommendation
summary: Recommendation engine for ProjexCloud: declarative per-domain models that produce ranked suggestions (next-best-action for an AE, next-best-content for a portal visitor, similar tickets for a support agent). Feedback events close the loop so models improve. Composes with sdk-lead-scoring + sdk-search + sdk-knowledge-rag.

events.name: recommendation.suggestion.served.v1
events.description: Suggestion delivered to a consumer; powers attribution + feedback.

events.name: recommendation.feedback.recorded.v1
events.description: User accepted/rejected/ignored a suggestion; feeds model improvement.

models.description: Per-model row: domain, version, weights/algo config.
Per-(subject, model) row: ranked items, served_at, expires_at.
Per-feedback row: suggestion_id, item_id, action (accept/reject/ignore), persona_id.

hooks.name: publishModel
hooks.description: Publish a new model version (per domain).

hooks.name: getSuggestions
hooks.description: Return ranked suggestions for a subject + domain. Tenant + permission scoped.

hooks.name: recordFeedback
hooks.description: Log user feedback against a served suggestion; feeds the model.

hooks.name: startRetrainer
hooks.description: Background trainer: re-fits weights from accumulated feedback per cadence.

scenarios.title: AE opens a deal → 5 ranked next-best-action suggestions
scenarios.when_to_use: AE's deal view loads; we surface 5 suggested next actions ('send proposal', 'schedule technical demo', 'introduce to security team') ranked by historic conversion.
scenarios.expected_outcome: 5 ranked actions returned with confidence scores. Emits .suggestion.served.v1 for attribution. AE can accept/reject — feedback feeds the next training pass.

scenarios.title: AE accepts a suggestion → feedback recorded
scenarios.when_to_use: AE clicks 'do this' on a suggestion; recordFeedback closes the loop so the next retrain weights this combination higher.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Feedback row written; emits .feedback.recorded.v1. Next retrainer pass uses this signal.

scenarios.title: Publish a content-recommender model for the customer portal
scenarios.when_to_use: Marketing wants 'related articles' suggestions on the customer portal — publish a content-similarity model.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Model published. Portal pages can call getSuggestions(domain='content-related', subject={kind:'article', id}) to render 'related articles'.

scenarios.title: Daily retrainer absorbs feedback into new weights
scenarios.when_to_use: Background retrainer runs nightly; re-fits weights using exponentially-decayed feedback (RECOMMENDATION_FEEDBACK_HALFLIFE_DAYS), publishes a new draft version.
scenarios.example_code:
import { startRetrainer } from '@projexlight/sdk-recommendation';
startRetrainer({ tenant_id, domain: 'next-best-action', interval_hours: 24 });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Nightly run produces a draft version; ops reviews + activates if KPIs hold. Emits .model.published.v1.

scenarios.title: Lead-score change triggers a fresh suggestion set
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive on lead_scoring.score.changed.v1 — when a lead heats up, pre-compute next-best-action suggestions so the AE sees them on dashboard load.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Suggestion row precomputed + cached. AE sees instant suggestions instead of a loading spinner.

compliance_posture.notes: Same explainability posture as sdk-lead-scoring — every suggestion traces to model version + contributing features for any regulator who asks 'why was this recommended'. Feedback events are PII-light; persona_id pinned for attribution.
